Photorealistic live-action anime adaptation. The combat shifts from a desperate struggle to an overwhelming display of absolute power. Maintain clear spatial relations: the master steps between the camera/antagonist and the child.

[Shot 1] (15-19s) Cut to a slow-motion extreme close-up, continuing from the frozen frame. <Subject 2>'s glowing purple claw is descending rapidly toward the collapsed child in the midground. The camera is positioned behind the child's shoulder, looking up at the descending claw. The child braces for impact, closing their eyes. The dark purple aura fills the screen.

[Shot 2] (19-23s) Sudden cut to a dramatic wide shot from a side angle. A streak of brilliant BLUE light flashes across the screen. <Subject 3> appears instantly between <Subject 2> (foreground) and the child (midground). He holds his long dark-steel sword horizontally, blocking <Subject 2>'s deadly claw strike with a deafening metallic CLANG. A massive shockwave of blue spiritual energy erupts, blowing <Subject 2> backward through the air and shattering the ground. The camera shakes violently.

[Shot 3] (23-30s) Cut to a high-speed dynamic profile tracking shot. <Subject 3> steps forward and draws his sword in a blindingly fast iaido slash. A massive, blinding arc of blue sword energy cuts across the screen. <Subject 2> is struck mid-air and blasted into a distant rock wall, instantly defeated. <Subject 3> stands tall, robes settling. He turns his back to the defeated enemy (facing the camera and the child) and gently places a hand on the child's head. Freeze the entire image for the final two seconds: <Subject 3> standing protectively with his sword sheathed, looking over his shoulder (towards the defeated enemy) with cold, stoic authority, while the child looks up at him with tears of relief and awe.

A sudden, deafening silence before the master arrives. The sharp, ear-splitting SNAP of the sword block. The roaring hum of blue spiritual pressure. A massive, thunderous boom as the final slash connects. Absolute silence on the final frozen frame, replaced by a gentle wind.

Photorealistic live-action sci-fi. Gritty, visceral cinematography emphasizing physical weight, momentum, and impact. No glowing effects or energy beams. Every punch, kick, and block must carry visible physical feedback (sweat, skin deformation, metallic clanking). Strict 180-degree rule: <Subject 1> is on the LEFT, <Subject 2> is on the RIGHT.

[Shot 1] (0-3s) A dynamic, hand-held medium shot. In the sunlit center of the room, <Subject 1> (left) throws a heavy, straight right punch. <Subject 2> (right) raises her left cybernetic arm. Metal meets flesh with a loud, sharp SMACK. The camera shakes violently. <Subject 2> smirks, her servos whining as she pushes him back.

[Shot 2] (3-6s) Cut to a fast-paced, low-angle tracking shot. <Subject 2> steps inside and drives a piston-powered knee into <Subject 1>'s ribs. He blocks partially but is sent stumbling backward through the white coffee table. Books, magazines, and coffee cups explode into the air. 

[Shot 3] (6-9s) Cut to an extreme close-up. <Subject 1> grabs a heavy book to shield his head as <Subject 2>'s right metal fist punches straight through it. Pages explode into confetti. <Subject 1> uses the distraction to headbutt her, then grabs her collar and hurls her sideways. 

[Shot 4] (9-12s) Cut to a chaotic, spinning mid-shot. <Subject 2> crashes into the floor-to-ceiling bookshelf. Rows of books and trinkets rain down on her. She roars and lunges forward, tackling <Subject 1> around the waist. They crash onto the yellow sofa, the leather creaking and tearing. Fists fly wildly at close range; elbows smash, knees strike. 

[Shot 5] (12-15s) Cut to a tense, ground-level close-up. <Subject 1> gains the upper hand, pivoting to wrap his arm around <Subject 2>'s neck. He pins her face-down into the yellow sofa cushion. <Subject 2>'s cybernetic arms claw at the fabric, sparks flying from her wrists as her servos strain to break the hold. Freeze the final frame: <Subject 1> on top, muscles bulging, pinning <Subject 2> down, surrounded by the wreckage of the room, with the bright sunlight streaming through the window behind them.

overall_soundscape:
Guttural, heavy breathing and grunts of exertion. The sharp, brutal SMACK of flesh on flesh. The high-pitched CLANG of metal fists hitting bone. The grinding of <Subject 2>'s cybernetic servos. The loud CRASH of wood breaking, books tumbling, and the leather sofa tearing. No magical sound effects.

non_diegetic_music:
A tense, relentless, percussive industrial beat. Heavy, distorted bass and erratic, frantic drumming. The music builds in intensity with each blow, reaching a frantic peak as they crash onto the sofa, then abruptly cuts to a dead, ringing silence on the frozen final frame.
